description: Canonical HyperAgent plan envelope per master prompt §HYPERAGENT. Codifies the plan-id, correlation-id, risk lane, success metrics, rollback plan, and approval policy that govern multi-step agent execution. Reference template: config/plan-templates/psr-rollout.json (Phase Δ Plan v3).

plan_version.description: Iterative plan version (v1, v2, v3, ...). Used when RLM critique or operator feedback produces a synthesized successor plan.

parent_plan.description: Optional reference to a parent plan_id when this plan is a sub-plan or successor.

correlation_id.description: Trace-id propagated through every event and write produced under this plan. Connects spine_events, AgentMemory entries, governance audits.

risk_level.description: Plan-wide risk classification. 'low' = additive-only; 'medium' = additive + minor mutations; 'medium-high' = production-write with rollback; 'high' = irreversible or wide blast radius.

budget_lane.description: Token + cost lane. 'micro' = cheap inline ops; 'standard' = normal LLM-path mutations; 'deep' = escalation-only premium reasoning.

target_services.description: Services the plan will modify. Used for blast-radius pre-check and impact assessment.

success_metrics.description: Hard and soft gates that determine plan success.

hard_gates.description: Must-pass criteria. Plan does not close until all hard_gates evaluate true.

soft_gates.description: Aspirational criteria; plan can close yellow if soft_gates partially met.

premium_allowed.description: Premium escalation policy. 'NO' = never; 'ESCALATION_ONLY' = with explicit premium_escalation_used event; 'ALLOWED' = unrestricted.

max_agent_fanout.description: Maximum concurrent sub-agents the plan may dispatch in a single mission step.

max_recursion_depth.description: Maximum nested chain depth. Prevents unbounded recursion in router or materializer.

rollback_plan.description: Per-phase rollback procedure keyed by phase identifier. Each phase entry describes the reversal action.

approval_policy.description: Per-phase approval gate. Maps phase to required approver class.

policy_profile.description: Compliance + governance profile applied to this plan. Determines which gates and policies apply at runtime.

spof_rollback_triggers.description: Single-point-of-failure rollback triggers per Plan v2 §SPOF. Each entry maps a SPOF condition to the trigger threshold and rollback action.

inventor_governance.description: Inventor experiment cost cap and concurrency limits per Plan v2 §inventor_governance.

captain.description: Identifier of the captain agent that authored / owns the plan.
